backlog_metadata.notes: MVP 1 items US-001-US-010 preserved; US-010 amended by DEC-211 (AC-028 superseded by AC-029). CR-003 amends DEC-201/DEC-214 for local STT and updated notice. HU11 authorization resolves BR-013/025 and approves quality/performance/resource targets and a configurable 30/day STT quota (DEC-219); empirical acceptance and Railway evidence remain pending. Planning fields stay null; team MoSCoW and Story Points remain source data. CR-004 supersedes the CR-003 Tiny model selection with Systran/faster-whisper-base for HU11/HU12. The requester approved implementation on 2026-11-09; approval by other team members is not established. Corpus-based quality testing, latency/memory verification and Railway validation remain pending. Historical CR-003 is preserved; the AC-071 model reference is reconciled without changing its latency threshold.

epics.name: Identity and Profile
epics.description: Registration, authentication, profile data, and password change.

epics.name: Score Publication and Ownership
epics.description: Create, validate, publish, edit, and delete textual scores.

epics.name: Discovery and Score Viewing
epics.description: Dashboard, feed, filtering, and score detail.

epics.name: Community Interaction
epics.description: Comments and reactions on other users' scores; voice comments (MVP 2).

epics.name: Voice and File Score Input
epics.description: Dictating a score by voice and loading a score from an .abc file into the editor.

epics.name: Listening and Audio Learning
epics.description: Spoken solfege, audio tutor, instrument playback and MP3 download for ABC scores.

epics.name: Audio Reliability and Cost Control
epics.description: Reuse of synthesized audio, voice fallback, authentication and usage limits for voice features.

acceptance_criteria.given: a visitor provides the information required by the approved registration flow
acceptance_criteria.then: an account is created or the user receives a clear validation result

acceptance_criteria.given: registration data is invalid or incomplete
acceptance_criteria.then: the account is not created and the user can identify that correction is required

user_story.i_want: to log in and log out
user_story.so_that: I can access or end access to protected functionality

acceptance_criteria.given: a registered user provides valid authentication information
acceptance_criteria.then: they can access protected functionality

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user chooses to log out
acceptance_criteria.then: protected functionality is no longer available without authenticating again

acceptance_criteria.given: authentication information is invalid
acceptance_criteria.then: access is not granted and the user receives a clear result

user_story.i_want: to manage my profile information and change my password
user_story.so_that: my account information remains under my control

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user opens their profile
acceptance_criteria.then: the approved profile fields are available to view or edit

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user submits valid profile changes
acceptance_criteria.then: the updated information is shown

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user submits invalid or incomplete password-change information
acceptance_criteria.then: the password is not changed and correction is indicated

user_story.i_want: to publish a short .abc or plain-text score with its context
user_story.so_that: I can share a musical idea with the community

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user provides a title, instrument, description, supported format, and non-empty content of at most 1,000 characters
acceptance_criteria.then: the score is published and its metadata is available

acceptance_criteria.given: the selected format is .abc and the content fails the defined basic syntax validation
acceptance_criteria.then: publication is rejected with a clear validation result

acceptance_criteria.given: the selected format is plain text and the content is non-empty and within the limit
acceptance_criteria.then: the content is accepted without requiring ABC syntax

acceptance_criteria.given: required publication information is missing, content is empty, content is longer than 1,000 characters, or the format is unsupported
acceptance_criteria.then: it is rejected and the correction is indicated

user_story.so_that: I can keep my shared score information current

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user owns a publication
acceptance_criteria.then: the publication reflects the updated information and remains subject to all score rules

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user does not own a publication
acceptance_criteria.then: the edit is not applied

user_story.so_that: I can control my shared content

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user owns a publication
acceptance_criteria.then: the publication is no longer available in the applicable product views

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user does not own a publication
acceptance_criteria.then: it is not deleted

user_story.i_want: to view recent personal and community scores and filter them by instrument
user_story.so_that: I can discover relevant musical content

acceptance_criteria.given: scores are available
acceptance_criteria.when: a user opens the applicable discovery view
acceptance_criteria.then: personal and community scores are displayed from newest to oldest, with 10 publications per page

acceptance_criteria.given: a user selects an instrument filter
acceptance_criteria.then: the displayed scores correspond to that instrument

acceptance_criteria.given: no score matches the selected filter
acceptance_criteria.then: the user receives an empty-result indication

user_story.i_want: to view a score's readable details
user_story.so_that: I can understand and use its textual musical content

acceptance_criteria.given: a published score is available
acceptance_criteria.when: a user opens its detail view
acceptance_criteria.then: its title, instrument, description, format, and readable textual content are displayed

acceptance_criteria.given: score content contains line breaks
acceptance_criteria.then: those line breaks remain distinguishable

acceptance_criteria.given: a score is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.then: the user receives a clear unavailable-result indication

user_story.i_want: to like another user's score and remove my like

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user views another user's score
acceptance_criteria.then: their reaction is shown as applied

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user has liked another user's score
acceptance_criteria.then: their reaction is no longer shown as applied

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthenticated user attempts to react
acceptance_criteria.then: the reaction is not applied and authentication is required

user_story.i_want: to comment on another user's score

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user views another user's score
acceptance_criteria.then: the comment is associated with that score and is visible in its detail context

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthenticated user attempts to comment
acceptance_criteria.then: the comment is not created and authentication is required

acceptance_criteria.given: a user has submitted a comment
acceptance_criteria.when: they attempt to edit or delete it
acceptance_criteria.then: the action is not available in MVP 1

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user authored a comment
acceptance_criteria.then: the comment, and its audio if it is a voice comment, is no longer available; other users cannot delete it

user_story.i_want: to dictate notes and bars in Spanish through the microphone
user_story.so_that: they are written as ABC notation in the editor without typing them

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user is on the score create or edit page and has been informed that audio is sent to Notara's backend and hosting infrastructure may process the request
acceptance_criteria.when: they press the microphone button and dictate "Compas cuatro cuartos, Do negra, Re corchea, Mi corchea" within 30 seconds
acceptance_criteria.then: the recording is transcribed

acceptance_criteria.given: the transcription uses only the supported vocabulary
acceptance_criteria.when: the result returns to the page
acceptance_criteria.then: ABC notation equivalent to `M:4/4` and `C D/2 E/2` is inserted into the content field, completed as defined by BR-025, the format is set to ABC, and nothing is published

acceptance_criteria.given: the recording is unintelligible or uses words outside the vocabulary
acceptance_criteria.then: the message "No se pudo interpretar el dictado musical" is shown and the content field is unchanged

acceptance_criteria.given: a user opens the dictation option
acceptance_criteria.then: the supported vocabulary is visible to the user

acceptance_criteria.given: a recording is in progress
acceptance_criteria.then: recording stops or is rejected with a clear message

acceptance_criteria.given: microphone permission is denied or unavailable
acceptance_criteria.then: a clear message is shown and the rest of the form remains usable

acceptance_criteria.given: content produced by dictation is in the field
acceptance_criteria.then: the MVP 1 publication rules are applied

acceptance_criteria.given: the authorized evaluation corpus contains at least 9 recordings from at least 3 different speakers
acceptance_criteria.when: all recordings are transcribed and parsed using the approved deterministic parser
acceptance_criteria.then: at least 7 of 9 produce the exact expected ABC; this target has not yet been measured

acceptance_criteria.given: the CR-004 approved multilingual Whisper Base model is loaded and the approved evaluation includes 30-second recordings
acceptance_criteria.when: transcription is measured over the approved evaluation run
acceptance_criteria.then: p95 is no more than 15 seconds and cold-start time is reported separately

acceptance_criteria.given: the complete service runs in a 1 GiB container under the approved HU11 test profile
acceptance_criteria.when: model load and inference are measured
acceptance_criteria.then: total service memory remains at or below 800 MiB and no more than one STT inference runs simultaneously per process

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user has reached the configured daily STT limit
acceptance_criteria.then: the service returns `STT_DAILY_LIMIT_REACHED` (429) without starting inference

acceptance_criteria.given: concurrent requests approach the user's daily quota
acceptance_criteria.then: the persistent per-user/UTC-day counter is reserved atomically; invalid/authentication/CSRF failures and requests rejected before inference admission do not count, while an admitted attempt counts even if transcription or parsing fails

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthenticated request, missing/invalid CSRF token, oversized audio, or an audio file with a disallowed type or signature is submitted
acceptance_criteria.when: the STT endpoint validates the request
acceptance_criteria.then: it rejects it before inference, returns a typed error, and does not consume quota

user_story.i_want: to record spoken observations on other users' scores
user_story.so_that: I can leave quick feedback published as text and audio

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user views another user's score
acceptance_criteria.when: they record a voice note of up to 30 seconds and confirm sending
acceptance_criteria.then: a comment is created with the transcribed text and a link to its recorded audio

acceptance_criteria.given: a score has a voice comment
acceptance_criteria.when: a user opens the score detail
acceptance_criteria.then: they can read the comment text and play its audio

acceptance_criteria.given: the transcription fails or is empty
acceptance_criteria.then: no comment is created, a clear message is shown, and the user can retry or write a text comment

acceptance_criteria.given: a user views their own score
acceptance_criteria.then: the voice comment option is not available

acceptance_criteria.given: an unauthenticated user views a score
acceptance_criteria.when: they try to record a voice comment
acceptance_criteria.then: recording is not available and authentication is required

acceptance_criteria.given: the author of a voice comment deletes it
acceptance_criteria.then: the comment and its audio are no longer available

acceptance_criteria.given: the same user has made STT requests through dictation and voice-comment transcription
acceptance_criteria.then: both flows share one persistent per-user/UTC-day quota and cannot each consume a separate limit

user_story.i_want: to hear a synthesized voice pronounce the notes in time
user_story.so_that: I can practice sight-reading and intonation

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user views a score with valid ABC
acceptance_criteria.then: a synthesized Spanish voice pronounces the note names ("Do, Re, Mi...") in score order

acceptance_criteria.given: the solfege audio is received
acceptance_criteria.then: playback starts in the application's player

acceptance_criteria.given: the voice engine supports pauses
acceptance_criteria.then: pauses reflect relative note durations; otherwise the pace is constant

acceptance_criteria.given: a user views a plain-text score
acceptance_criteria.then: they are disabled with "Disponible solo para partituras en ABC"

acceptance_criteria.given: a valid ABC score contains elements that cannot be rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: a clear message is shown and no server error occurs

acceptance_criteria.given: a user has requested 20 new syntheses today
acceptance_criteria.when: they request solfege that is not stored
acceptance_criteria.then: no synthesis is made, a clear message is shown, and stored audio remains available

user_story.i_want: to hear a short spoken summary of the score's technical content
user_story.so_that: I understand its clef, meter and difficulty before practicing it

acceptance_criteria.given: an authenticated user views a score with valid ABC
acceptance_criteria.then: a spoken locution states the clef, the meter and the estimated difficulty (e.g. "Partitura en clave de Sol, compas de 4/4, dificultad estimada: media")

acceptance_criteria.given: the tutor locution is generated
acceptance_criteria.then: it is computed with BR-014 and announced as "dificultad estimada"

acceptance_criteria.given: a user views a plain-text score or an ABC score that cannot be rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: the option is disabled with "Disponible solo para partituras en ABC", or a clear message is shown

items.title: Play the score with an instrument

user_story.i_want: to hear the instrument sound performing the score
user_story.so_that: I know exactly how the melody should sound

acceptance_criteria.given: a user views a score with valid ABC
acceptance_criteria.then: the notes are played with a piano sound generated in the browser, without calling an external audio service

acceptance_criteria.given: a user views a plain-text score or an ABC score that cannot be rendered
acceptance_criteria.then: the option is disabled with "Disponible solo para partituras en ABC", or a clear message is shown

acceptance_criteria.given: a user plays a score with the instrument
acceptance_criteria.then: it does not count toward the daily synthesis limit

user_story.as_a: system administrator (operator perspective; no product role)
user_story.i_want: audio already generated by the voice provider to be stored and reused
user_story.so_that: monthly credits are not exceeded and duplicate requests are avoided

acceptance_criteria.given: a score requests its solfege audio for the first time
acceptance_criteria.then: it is stored, identified by score content, voice and language

acceptance_criteria.given: the same audio is already stored
acceptance_criteria.then: the stored audio is returned without calling the provider

acceptance_criteria.given: a score's content was edited after its audio was stored
acceptance_criteria.then: new audio is generated and the old one is not served

acceptance_criteria.given: storing a generated audio fails
acceptance_criteria.then: the user still receives the audio

items.title: Fall back to a free voice

user_story.as_a: project developer (operator perspective; no product role)
user_story.i_want: the system to switch to a free voice library when the commercial voice service fails or has no credits
user_story.so_that: audio stays available during project demonstrations

acceptance_criteria.given: the commercial voice provider rejects the request for lack of credits (402) or rate limiting (429)
acceptance_criteria.then: the fallback voice generates the audio and the user receives no server error

acceptance_criteria.given: the commercial voice provider is unavailable
acceptance_criteria.then: the fallback voice generates the audio

acceptance_criteria.given: both the commercial and the fallback voice fail
acceptance_criteria.then: a clear message is shown and no server error occurs

acceptance_criteria.given: the fallback voice produced an audio
acceptance_criteria.then: the user is not told which voice was used and the event is logged

acceptance_criteria.given: the platform runs in development or automated testing
acceptance_criteria.then: the fallback voice is used by default

user_story.i_want: to download the synthesized audio to my device
user_story.so_that: I can listen to it without an internet connection

acceptance_criteria.given: the spoken solfege of an `.abc` score has been synthesized
acceptance_criteria.then: the browser downloads an `.mp3` file containing the spoken solfege

acceptance_criteria.given: a user views a plain-text score
acceptance_criteria.then: it is not available, as for the other listening options

items.title: Load a score from an .abc file

user_story.as_a: music student, hobbyist musician or music teacher
user_story.i_want: to load an `.abc` file from my device when creating or editing a score
user_story.so_that: its content is shown as text in the score field without copying and pasting it

acceptance_criteria.given: a user is on the score create or edit page
acceptance_criteria.when: they select a file with the `.abc` extension
acceptance_criteria.then: the format changes to ABC and the file text appears in the content field with its line breaks, editable before publishing

acceptance_criteria.given: the content field already has content
acceptance_criteria.then: confirmation is requested before replacing it, and cancelling keeps the existing content

acceptance_criteria.given: the file is not `.abc`, is empty, is not readable text or exceeds 1,000 characters
acceptance_criteria.when: the user tries to load it
acceptance_criteria.then: a clear message is shown and the current content is not modified

acceptance_criteria.given: loaded content is in the field
acceptance_criteria.then: the MVP 1 validations apply and only the text is kept; the file is not stored
